title: Ravina bar Avina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is cited in Vayikra Rabbah 4:3: he said, “A parable of a guest who used to come at sunrise,” etc. Hyman suspects a scribal error and says the reading should follow the wording he reports from Yalkut, Mishlei, remez 959: “Rabbi Bivi bar Ravina said.”

notes.text: The consulted Vayikra Rabbah has Ravina bar Avina. The parallel sunrise parable in the consulted Yalkut reads Biva bar Avina. Hyman reports Bivi bar Ravina.
